name: io.github.Buggy1111/agent-lease-mcp
title: Agent Lease
description: Keep Claude Code and Codex off each other's files: hook-enforced path leases, presence, messages.

environmentVariables.name: AGENT_NAME
environmentVariables.description: This agent's name in the room, e.g. claude-code or codex. Must match the hooks.

environmentVariables.name: AGENT_LEASE_DB
environmentVariables.description: Path to the shared SQLite room (default ~/.agent-lease/room.db).
